name: sprint17_meanrev_10m_altbasket
hypothesis: sprint02's 10-min down-move mean-reversion signal (majors FAIL, t=-30.2) may retain a net edge on the thinner 8-alt basket where price impact persists longer, closing the last untested cell in the 5-signal x {majors,alts} matrix.
power_argument: T2 cost floor ~26bp, dispersion ~33bp std -> min detectable edge at n=300,t=2 ~3.8bp. 8 symbols x ~92 validation days x cap8/day = up to 5888 possible entries; sprint04 realized 5888/5888 under identical caps on this basket, so n>=300 is near-certain.
